literal: Do not think of things that diminish the mind; do not accept the friendship of those who, in times of distress, cut off the path of support.
translation: Never harbor thoughts that diminish the greatness of your mind; likewise, never accept the friendship of those who abandon you in times of distress.
modern: மனம் தளரக்கூடிய எண்ணங்களை நினைக்க வேண்டாம்; துன்பம் வரும் காலத்தில் வழியைக் கைவிட்டு விலகிப் போகிறவர்களின் நட்பைக் கொள்ள வேண்டாம்.
explanation: This couplet advises the learner on two crucial things to avoid for maintaining personal dignity and strength. First, one must never think of thoughts that weaken or diminish the resolve and greatness of the mind (உள்ளம் சிறுகுவ உள்ளற்க). Second, one must never accept the friendship of those who cut off support (ஆற்றறுப்பார்) and leave one stranded in times of distress (அல்லற்கண்). Here, 'ஆற்று' refers to the path of support or strength, and 'அறுப்பார்' refers to those who sever that connection when it is needed most. True strength lies in keeping the mind elevated and avoiding fair-weather friends.
